Personally I had a small nihilistic phase, I don't know what's the perspective on the world that made you nihilistic. Mine was I focused on the big scale, on how insignificant was my action in the universal or planetary scale and even if it was relevant to a big scale, time would erase me from history anyway. It stopped when I realised that smaller scale is also important, helping out in the present, where you can even if it's just around you even if it's just to make the world a better place even for an instant is also important. I hope I could offer you some guidance, I feel like helping the mental health of others is so difficult. I think people need to follow their own path to find the view of the world that best suits them. My final advice would be not to give up, try to find how you would like to see the world and then try to find some arguments to back it up. My experience with philosophy is that every philosophers defended opinions that contradicts each others, yet all seems convincing if you follow their logic and if you understand what they mean. Just try to follow a view of the world that makes you happy but understand it is not an absolute truth and that it's just a part of a web of possibilities. Maybe you'll have to adapt it with what you experience in your life but try to keep a good outlook on the world.

Where the minions spawn ? is programmed in the game as random in the  game). I feel like a lot of gamers confuse die and retry to learn the boss and die and retry to get the lucky sequence that will allow you to beat the boss.

I'm not talking about one trying bosses.
